headline: Keep mobile apps connected to Home Assistant
intro: The Mobile App integration is the generic platform that lets Home Assistant mobile apps integrate with your server. It is enabled by default, and Home Assistant recommends keeping it enabled when you use an app that integrates with Home Assistant.
highlights: Keep the integration enabled for mobile apps that connect to Home Assistant
It is on by default unless you removed or disabled the default_config: entry
If default_config: is absent, enable the integration manually with mobile_app:

flow.title: Keep the mobile app platform available
stages: If it is absent, add mobile_app: to configuration.yaml
Consult Companion documentation for app guidance
